title: A future king & donkeys
textBlocks:
Hello Bravehearts
In today’s true Bible story
we meet Saul.

Saul’s dads DONKEY’S have gone missing
and Saul is out looking for them

What do we learn about the future king of Israel 
while he looks for his dad’s donkeys?
Listen to today’s story and see what you learn about Saul
Was he mean, did he care about his dad, was he naughty, was he obedient?

Did you see how Saul obeyed his dad and followed instructions
He cared - he was worried about his dad
Fun time - Find the odd one out
